 Type 1 diabetes
 Calcitonin ≥50 ng/L
 Use of a GLP-1 receptor agonist (exenatide, liraglutide or other) or pramlintide or any DPP-4
inhibitor within the 3 months prior to screening
 Use of insulin other than human NPH insulin or long-acting insulin analogue or premixed insulin
within 3 months prior to screening. Short-term use of other insulin during this period in
connection with intercurrent illness is allowed, at Investigator’s discretion
 Acute decompensation of glycemic control
 Acute coronary or cerebrovascular event in the previous 14 days
 Currently planned coronary, carotid, or peripheral artery revascularization
 Chronic heart failure (NYHA class IV)
 Current continuous renal replacement therapy
 End-stage liver disease
 History of solid organ transplant or awaiting solid organ transplant
 Malignant neoplasm
 Family or personal history of multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2 or familial medullary thyroid
carcinoma
 Personal history of non-familial medullary thyroid carcinoma
